definitionEn: A pair consisting of a set and a family of subsets containing the empty set and the whole set and closed under arbitrary unions and finite intersections.
definitionZh: 集合与其开集族组成的二元组；开集族含空集和全集，并对任意并及有限交封闭。
example: $\{\varnothing,\{a\},\{a,b\}\}$ is a topology on $\{a,b\}$.
distinction: Hausdorff separation and countability are additional axioms, not part of this definition.

definitionSources.label: Anton Petrunin — A minimalist intro to topology

translationSources.label: Bao Zhiqiang — Peking University topology syllabus
translationSources.locator: 第1周9月14日：拓扑公理，拓扑空间中的一些基本概念，度量空间

definitionEn: The property that every open cover of a topological space admits a finite subcover; Hausdorff separation is not imposed here.
definitionZh: 拓扑空间的每个开覆盖均有有限子覆盖的性质；此处不把 Hausdorff 条件包含在定义内。
example: $[0,1]$ is compact; the cover $(1/n,1)$ shows $(0,1)$ is not.
distinction: Closed and bounded characterizes compact subsets of Euclidean space, not arbitrary spaces.

definitionSources.label: Anton Petrunin — A minimalist intro to topology

translationSources.label: Bao Zhiqiang — Peking University topology syllabus
translationSources.locator: 第5周10月12日：紧致与列紧；特别关注：紧致性

definitionEn: A subset belonging to the specified topology of a space.
definitionZh: 属于给定拓扑的子集。
example: $(0,1)$ is open in $\mathbb R$, and $[0,1)$ is open in the subspace $[0,1]$.
distinction: Openness depends on the ambient space; it does not mean that an interval has two missing endpoints in every context.

definitionSources.label: Anton Petrunin — A minimalist intro to topology

translationSources.label: Bao Zhiqiang — Peking University topology syllabus
translationSources.locator: 第1周9月14日，主要概念：开集

definitionEn: A subset whose complement in the specified ambient topological space is open.
definitionZh: 在指定拓扑空间中，其补集为开集的子集。
example: $\mathbb Z$ is closed in the usual real line.
distinction: A set may be both open and closed; closedness is not the negation of openness.

definitionSources.label: Anton Petrunin — A minimalist intro to topology

translationSources.label: Bao Zhiqiang — Peking University topology syllabus
translationSources.locator: 第1周9月14日，主要概念：闭集

definitionEn: A family of open subsets such that every open subset is a union of members of that family.
definitionZh: 由开集组成的族，使每个开集均可写成该族中若干成员的并。
example: Intervals with rational endpoints form a basis for the usual topology on $\mathbb R$.
distinction: A subbasis requires finite intersections before arbitrary unions; a basis does not.

definitionSources.label: Anton Petrunin — A minimalist intro to topology

translationSources.label: Bao Zhiqiang — Peking University topology syllabus
translationSources.locator: 第2周9月26日，主要概念：拓扑基

definitionEn: For a subset A of a topological space X, the topology on A consisting of intersections of A with open subsets of X.
definitionZh: 对 $A\subseteq X$，由 $A$ 与 $X$ 的开集的所有交集构成的拓扑。
example: $[0,1/2)$ is relatively open in $[0,1]$.
distinction: Relatively open subsets need not be open in the ambient space.

definitionSources.label: Anton Petrunin — A minimalist intro to topology

translationSources.label: Bao Zhiqiang — Peking University topology syllabus
translationSources.locator: 第1周9月14日，主要概念：子空间拓扑

definitionEn: A Cartesian product equipped with the coarsest topology making every coordinate projection continuous; basic opens restrict only finitely many coordinates.
definitionZh: 在笛卡尔积上赋予使各坐标投射连续的最粗拓扑；基本开集仅限制有限多个坐标。
example: The product topology on $\mathbb R^2$ is generated by open rectangles.
distinction: The Chinese headword names the equipped space; for infinite products, allowing unrestricted open conditions in every coordinate gives the generally finer box topology.

definitionSources.label: Anton Petrunin — A minimalist intro to topology
definitionSources.locator: Chapter 6A, Product space; Chapter 7G, Product spaces

translationSources.label: Bao Zhiqiang — Peking University topology syllabus
translationSources.locator: 第2周9月26日：拓扑基与邻域基，乘积空间，可数公理（上）

definitionEn: For a surjection q from a topological space X onto a set Y, the topology in which U is open in Y exactly when its inverse image under q is open in X.
definitionZh: 对满射 $q:X\to Y$，规定 $U\subseteq Y$ 为开集当且仅当 $q^{-1}(U)$ 在 $X$ 中开，由此得到的拓扑。
example: Identifying the endpoints of $[0,1]$ yields a quotient homeomorphic to the circle.
distinction: A continuous surjection need not give its target the quotient topology.

definitionSources.label: Anton Petrunin — A minimalist intro to topology

translationSources.label: Bao Zhiqiang — Peking University topology syllabus
translationSources.locator: 第7周10月26日，主要概念：商拓扑

definitionEn: A topological space in which any two distinct points have disjoint open neighborhoods.
definitionZh: 任意两个不同点都有互不相交的开邻域的拓扑空间。
example: Any metric space is Hausdorff by taking balls of radius less than half the distance between two points.
distinction: Closed singletons alone give T1 separation, which is weaker.

definitionSources.label: Anton Petrunin — A minimalist intro to topology

translationSources.label: Bao Zhiqiang — Peking University topology syllabus
translationSources.locator: 第3周9月28日，主要概念：Hausdorff 空间

definitionEn: A bijective continuous map of topological spaces whose inverse is also continuous.
definitionZh: 拓扑空间之间的双射，且该映射及其逆映射均连续。
example: $x\mapsto e^x$ is a homeomorphism from $\mathbb R$ to $(0,\infty)$.
distinction: Continuity and bijectivity alone do not imply continuity of the inverse.

definitionSources.label: Anton Petrunin — A minimalist intro to topology

translationSources.label: Bao Zhiqiang — Peking University topology syllabus
translationSources.locator: 第2周9月19日，主要概念：同胚

definitionEn: An open subset of a topological space containing the specified point.
definitionZh: 含指定点的开集；本条采用开邻域约定。
example: $(-1,1)$ is an open neighborhood of $0$ in $\mathbb R$.
distinction: Some authors allow any set containing an open neighborhood to be called a neighborhood; that broader convention includes $[-1,1]$.

definitionSources.label: Anton Petrunin — A minimalist intro to topology

translationSources.label: Bao Zhiqiang — Peking University topology syllabus
translationSources.locator: 第1周9月14日，主要概念：邻域

definitionEn: The intersection of all closed subsets of the ambient space containing the given subset.
definitionZh: 包含给定子集的所有闭集的交，亦即包含它的最小闭集。
example: The closure of $\mathbb Q$ in $\mathbb R$ is $\mathbb R$.
distinction: A point belongs to the closure if every open neighborhood meets the subset; a sequence characterization needs extra hypotheses.

definitionSources.label: Anton Petrunin — A minimalist intro to topology

translationSources.label: Bao Zhiqiang — Peking University topology syllabus
translationSources.locator: 第1周9月14日，主要概念：闭包

definitionEn: The union of all open subsets of the ambient space contained in the given subset.
definitionZh: 包含于给定子集的所有开集的并，亦即其最大的开子集。
example: The interior of $[0,1]$ in $\mathbb R$ is $(0,1)$.
distinction: Interior is relative to the ambient topology; the same interval is all interior when it is the entire ambient space.

definitionSources.label: Anton Petrunin — A minimalist intro to topology

translationSources.label: Bao Zhiqiang — Peking University topology syllabus
translationSources.locator: 第1周9月14日，主要概念：内部

definitionEn: The topology on a set in which every subset is open.
definitionZh: 把集合的全部子集都规定为开集的拓扑。
example: Every subset of $\mathbb Z$ is open in its usual subspace topology.
distinction: A subset being discrete is different from the entire ambient space having discrete topology; a discrete subspace need not be closed.

definitionSources.label: Anton Petrunin — A minimalist intro to topology

translationSources.label: Bao Zhiqiang — Peking University topology syllabus
translationSources.locator: 第1周9月14日，常用例子：离散拓扑

definitionEn: A subset whose closure equals the entire ambient topological space.
definitionZh: 闭包等于整个拓扑空间的子集。
example: $\mathbb Q$ is dense in $\mathbb R$.
distinction: Density does not imply having positive measure or containing an open interval.

definitionSources.label: Anton Petrunin — A minimalist intro to topology
definitionSources.locator: Chapter 3B, Interior and closure; 8C, Nets and separability

translationSources.label: Bao Zhiqiang — Peking University topology syllabus
translationSources.locator: 第1周9月14日，主要概念：稠密

definitionEn: A topological space admitting a countable dense subset.
definitionZh: 存在可数稠密子集的拓扑空间。
example: The usual real line is separable because $\mathbb Q$ is countable and dense.
distinction: In metric spaces separability is equivalent to second countability, but the equivalence fails for arbitrary topologies.

definitionSources.label: Anton Petrunin — A minimalist intro to topology
definitionSources.locator: Chapter 8C, Nets and separability, printed p. 57

translationSources.label: Bao Zhiqiang — Peking University topology syllabus
translationSources.locator: 第1周9月14日，主要概念：可分

definitionEn: A space in which every point has a countable basis of open neighborhoods: every open neighborhood contains a member of that basis.
definitionZh: 每一点均有可数开邻域基，即该点的任意开邻域都包含基中的某个成员。
example: Metric balls $B(x,1/n)$ give such a basis at $x$.
distinction: The basis may depend on the point; this is weaker than a countable basis for the whole topology. C1 is the source's notation.

definitionSources.label: Anton Petrunin — A minimalist intro to topology

translationSources.label: Bao Zhiqiang — Peking University topology syllabus
translationSources.locator: 第2周9月26日，主要概念：C_{1} 可数公理

definitionEn: A topological space whose topology has a countable basis.
definitionZh: 其拓扑具有可数基的拓扑空间。
example: Rational open intervals give a countable basis for $\mathbb R$.
distinction: Second countability is global; an uncountable discrete space is first countable but not second countable. C2 follows the cited notation.

definitionSources.label: Anton Petrunin — A minimalist intro to topology

translationSources.label: Bao Zhiqiang — Peking University topology syllabus
translationSources.locator: 第2周9月26日，主要概念：C_{2} 可数公理

definitionEn: A topological space in which every singleton is closed.
definitionZh: 每个单点集均为闭集的拓扑空间。
example: An infinite set with the cofinite topology is T1.
distinction: T1 does not imply Hausdorff separation: two nonempty opens in an infinite cofinite space always intersect.

definitionSources.label: Anton Petrunin — A minimalist intro to topology

translationSources.label: Bao Zhiqiang — Peking University topology syllabus
translationSources.locator: 第3周9月28日，主要概念：T_{1} 分离公理

definitionEn: A space in which a point and a disjoint closed subset can be enclosed in disjoint open sets; T1 is not included in this record.
definitionZh: 点与不含该点的闭集可用互不相交的开集分开的空间；本条不附加 T1 条件。
example: Every metric space satisfies this separation property.
distinction: Some authors include T1 in regular or T3; the cited syllabus explicitly treats T1 plus T3 separately.

definitionSources.label: Anton Petrunin — A minimalist intro to topology
definitionSources.locator: Chapter 9E, Comments, separation-condition list, printed pp. 70–71

translationSources.label: Bao Zhiqiang — Peking University topology syllabus

definitionEn: A space in which any two disjoint closed subsets have disjoint open neighborhoods; T1 is not included here.
definitionZh: 任意两个不交闭集均可被不交开集分别包含的空间；本条不附加 T1。
example: Metric spaces separate disjoint closed sets using their distance functions.
distinction: This is topological normality, unrelated to normal subgroups or Gaussian distributions; definitions including T1 are stronger.

definitionSources.label: Anton Petrunin — A minimalist intro to topology
definitionSources.locator: Chapter 9E, Comments, Exercise 9.24 and separation-condition list

translationSources.label: Bao Zhiqiang — Peking University topology syllabus

definitionEn: The property that every sequence in a space has a subsequence converging to a point of that space.
definitionZh: 空间中的任意序列都有收敛到该空间内某点的子序列。
example: Every sequence in $[0,1]$ has a convergent subsequence with limit in $[0,1]$.
distinction: Equivalent to open-cover compactness for metric spaces; not an unrestricted equivalence in topology.

definitionSources.label: Anton Petrunin — A minimalist intro to topology
definitionSources.locator: Chapter 8B, Compactness implies sequential compactness; 8E, converse

translationSources.label: Bao Zhiqiang — Peking University topology syllabus
translationSources.locator: 第5周10月12日，主要概念：列紧

definitionEn: A topological space whose topology is induced by some metric.
definitionZh: 存在一个度量，其诱导拓扑恰为给定拓扑的空间。
example: The usual circle is metrizable by the restricted Euclidean distance.
distinction: A displayed metric is extra data; different metrics may induce the same topology while having different completeness properties.

definitionSources.label: Anton Petrunin — A minimalist intro to topology

translationSources.label: Bao Zhiqiang — Peking University topology syllabus
translationSources.locator: 第5周10月10日，主要概念：可度量化

definitionEn: For a noncompact locally compact Hausdorff space X, the compact Hausdorff space formed by adding infinity, whose neighborhoods have compact closed complements in X.
definitionZh: 对非紧局部紧 Hausdorff 空间添一个无穷远点；该点的开邻域的补集在原空间中紧且闭，由此得到紧 Hausdorff 空间。
example: The one-point compactification of $\mathbb R$ is homeomorphic to $S^1$.
distinction: The closed-compact-complement construction exists more generally, but the stated hypotheses ensure the intended Hausdorff compactification and dense inclusion.

definitionSources.label: Anton Petrunin — A minimalist intro to topology

translationSources.label: Bao Zhiqiang — Peking University topology syllabus
translationSources.locator: 第5周10月12日，主要概念：一点紧化

definitionEn: A space with no decomposition into two disjoint nonempty open subsets; the empty space is included here.
definitionZh: 不能分成两个非空不交开集之并的空间；本条把空空间也视为连通。
example: $[0,1]$ is connected; $[0,1]\cup[2,3]$ is not.
distinction: Connectedness need not imply path connectedness. Petrunin excludes the empty space; this record states its own convention.

definitionSources.label: Anton Petrunin — A minimalist intro to topology

translationSources.label: Bao Zhiqiang — Peking University topology syllabus
translationSources.locator: 第6周10月17日，主要概念：连通

definitionEn: A space in which every pair of points is joined by a continuous map from the unit interval.
definitionZh: 任意两点都可由从 $[0,1]$ 出发的连续道路连接的空间。
example: A convex subset of $\mathbb R^n$ is path connected by straight segments.
distinction: Paths may cross themselves and need not be embeddings; path connectedness is stronger than connectedness.

definitionSources.label: Anton Petrunin — A minimalist intro to topology

translationSources.label: Bao Zhiqiang — Peking University topology syllabus
translationSources.locator: 第7周10月24日，主要概念：道路连通

definitionEn: A maximal connected subset of a topological space.
definitionZh: 拓扑空间中关于包含关系极大的连通子集。
example: Each singleton is a connected component of $\mathbb Q$.
distinction: Components are closed but need not be open; local connectedness makes them open.

definitionSources.label: Anton Petrunin — A minimalist intro to topology

translationSources.label: Bao Zhiqiang — Peking University topology syllabus
translationSources.locator: 第6周10月17日，主要概念：连通分支

definitionEn: An equivalence class under the relation that two points can be joined by a path in the space.
definitionZh: 按两点之间存在道路这一等价关系得到的等价类。
example: The topologist's sine curve has a graph path component and a separate vertical-segment path component.
distinction: A path component is contained in a connected component, but equality needs additional hypotheses such as local path connectedness.

definitionSources.label: Anton Petrunin — A minimalist intro to topology

translationSources.label: Bao Zhiqiang — Peking University topology syllabus
translationSources.locator: 第7周10月24日，主要概念：道路分支

definitionEn: A space in which every open neighborhood of a point contains a connected open neighborhood of that point.
definitionZh: 任一点的任意开邻域内都含该点的连通开邻域的空间。
example: Euclidean balls show $\mathbb R^n$ is locally connected.
distinction: Being connected globally does not imply local connectedness, as the topologist's sine curve demonstrates.

definitionSources.label: Anton Petrunin — A minimalist intro to topology

translationSources.label: Bao Zhiqiang — Peking University topology syllabus
translationSources.locator: 第6周10月17日，主要概念：局部连通

definitionEn: A space in which every open neighborhood of a point contains a path connected open neighborhood of that point.
definitionZh: 任一点的每个开邻域内均含该点的道路连通开邻域的空间。
example: Every topological manifold is locally path connected through its coordinate balls.
distinction: On such spaces path components are open and coincide with connected components; global path connectedness alone does not suffice.

definitionSources.label: Anton Petrunin — A minimalist intro to topology

translationSources.label: Bao Zhiqiang — Peking University topology syllabus
translationSources.locator: 第7周10月24日，主要概念：局部道路连通

definitionEn: A surjective map q of topological spaces such that a subset of the target is open exactly when its inverse image under q is open.
definitionZh: 拓扑空间间的满射 $q$，满足目标中的子集开当且仅当其原像开。
example: The endpoint-identification map $[0,1]\to S^1$ is quotient.
distinction: A continuous surjection supplies only one direction of the defining equivalence.

definitionSources.label: Anton Petrunin — A minimalist intro to topology

translationSources.label: Bao Zhiqiang — Peking University topology syllabus
translationSources.locator: 第7周10月26日，主要概念：商映射

definitionEn: A continuous map that is a homeomorphism onto its image equipped with the subspace topology.
definitionZh: 到其像的同胚映射，其中像使用目标空间的子空间拓扑。
example: The inclusion $S^1\hookrightarrow\mathbb R^2$ is a topological embedding.
distinction: This imposes no differential-rank condition; smooth embeddings additionally require immersion.

definitionSources.label: Anton Petrunin — A minimalist intro to topology

translationSources.label: Bao Zhiqiang — Peking University topology syllabus
translationSources.locator: 第2周9月19日，常用例子：嵌入映射

definitionEn: A continuous map H from X times the unit interval to Y whose endpoint slices are the specified continuous maps X to Y.
definitionZh: 连续映射 $H:X\times[0,1]\to Y$，其两端切片分别为给定的两个连续映射。
example: For maps into a convex Euclidean set, $H(x,t)=(1-t)f(x)+tg(x)$ is a homotopy.
distinction: Continuity must be joint in x and t; based or relative homotopies impose additional fixed-point conditions.

definitionSources.label: Allen Hatcher — Algebraic Topology
definitionSources.locator: Chapter 0, Homotopy and Homotopy Type, printed p. 3

translationSources.label: Bao Zhiqiang — Peking University topology syllabus
translationSources.locator: 第10周11月14日，主要概念：同伦

definitionEn: A continuous map f:X to Y admitting a continuous g:Y to X such that both composites are homotopic to the corresponding identities.
definitionZh: 连续映射 $f:X\to Y$ 存在连续的同伦逆 $g:Y\to X$，使两个复合分别同伦于恒等映射。
example: The inclusion $S^1\hookrightarrow\mathbb R^2\setminus\{0\}$ is a homotopy equivalence.
distinction: A homotopy equivalence need not be a bijection or a homeomorphism.

definitionSources.label: Allen Hatcher — Algebraic Topology
definitionSources.locator: Chapter 0, Homotopy and Homotopy Type, printed pp. 3–4

translationSources.label: Bao Zhiqiang — Peking University topology syllabus
translationSources.locator: 第11周11月23日，主要概念：同伦等价

definitionEn: A continuous map homotopic to a constant map, with any required based or relative condition stated separately.
definitionZh: 同伦于常值映射的连续映射；若要求保基点或相对某子集，应另行说明。
example: A map into $\mathbb R^n$ is null homotopic by linear contraction.
distinction: For a loop, contraction in the fundamental group fixes its endpoint basepoint; an unqualified null homotopy of general maps does not.

definitionSources.label: Allen Hatcher — Algebraic Topology
definitionSources.locator: Chapter 0, Homotopy and Homotopy Type, printed pp. 3–4

translationSources.label: Bao Zhiqiang — Peking University topology syllabus
translationSources.locator: 第10周11月14日，主要概念：零伦

definitionEn: A nonempty topological space whose identity map is homotopic to a constant map.
definitionZh: 非空拓扑空间，其恒等映射同伦于一个常值映射。
example: Every nonempty convex subset of $\mathbb R^n$ is contractible.
distinction: Contractibility implies trivial positive homotopy and reduced homology, but trivial homology alone does not imply contractibility.

definitionSources.label: Allen Hatcher — Algebraic Topology
definitionSources.locator: Chapter 0, Homotopy and Homotopy Type, printed p. 4

translationSources.label: Bao Zhiqiang — Peking University topology syllabus
translationSources.locator: 第11周11月23日，主要概念：可缩空间

definitionEn: A subspace A of X for which a homotopy of the identity of X to a retraction onto A fixes every point of A at every time.
definitionZh: 子空间 $A\subseteq X$，存在从 $X$ 的恒等映射到映向 $A$ 的收缩映射的同伦，且全程固定 $A$ 中每一点。
example: The punctured plane strongly deformation retracts onto $S^1$ by radial motion.
distinction: Some authors use deformation retract without the fixed-subspace requirement; this record uses the strong convention.

definitionSources.label: Allen Hatcher — Algebraic Topology
definitionSources.locator: Chapter 0, deformation retraction definition, printed p. 2

translationSources.label: Bao Zhiqiang — Peking University topology syllabus
translationSources.locator: 第11周11月23日，主要概念：形变收缩，强形变收缩

definitionEn: The group of loops at a chosen point modulo homotopy fixing the endpoints, with multiplication given here by traversing the first loop then the second.
definitionZh: 以指定点为基点的闭道路在定端同伦下的等价类组成的群；乘积约定先走第一条再走第二条。
example: $\pi_1(S^1,1)\cong\mathbb Z$ via winding number.
distinction: Changing basepoint along different paths can change the comparison by an inner automorphism.

definitionSources.label: Allen Hatcher — Algebraic Topology
definitionSources.locator: §1.1, Paths and Homotopy; The Fundamental Group of the Circle

translationSources.label: Bao Zhiqiang — Peking University topology syllabus
translationSources.locator: 第11周11月21日，主要概念：基本群

definitionEn: A nonempty path connected space whose fundamental group at one, hence every, basepoint is trivial.
definitionZh: 非空道路连通空间，且任一基点处的基本群为平凡群。
example: $S^n$ is simply connected for $n\geq2$.
distinction: Trivial fundamental groups on each component do not by themselves imply simple connectivity; path connectedness is required.

definitionSources.label: Allen Hatcher — Algebraic Topology

translationSources.label: Bao Zhiqiang — Peking University topology syllabus
translationSources.locator: 第11周11月21日，主要概念：单连通

definitionEn: A space E with a continuous surjection to B such that each point of B has a neighborhood whose inverse image splits into disjoint open sheets each homeomorphic to that neighborhood.
definitionZh: 空间 $E$ 连同连续满射 $p:E\to B$；底空间每一点都有开邻域，其原像为不交开片之并，每片由 $p$ 同胚地映到该邻域。
example: $t\mapsto e^{2\pi it}$ covers $S^1$ by $\mathbb R$.
distinction: A local homeomorphism is not automatically a covering map; the whole neighborhood must be evenly covered.

definitionSources.label: Allen Hatcher — Algebraic Topology

translationSources.label: Li Xiaobin — Southwest Jiaotong University, Gromov–Witten study guide
translationSources.locator: §1.2 基础拓扑学，核心内容：覆盖空间

translationSources.label: Bao Zhiqiang — Peking University topology syllabus
translationSources.locator: 第13周12月7日：复迭空间；主要概念：复迭空间

definitionEn: A covering with path connected and simply connected total space.
definitionZh: 总空间道路连通且单连通的复迭空间。
example: $\mathbb R\to S^1$ is a universal covering.
distinction: Existence is guaranteed for path connected, locally path connected, semilocally simply connected bases, not arbitrary spaces.

definitionSources.label: Allen Hatcher — Algebraic Topology
definitionSources.locator: §1.3, Classification of Covering Spaces, universal covering discussion

translationSources.label: Bao Zhiqiang — Peking University topology syllabus
translationSources.locator: 第15周12月19日，主要概念：泛复迭空间

definitionEn: A homeomorphism of a covering's total space E satisfying p composed with that homeomorphism equals p.
definitionZh: 复迭空间总空间 $E$ 的同胚 $h$，满足 $p\circ h=p$。
example: Integer translations are deck transformations of $\mathbb R\to S^1$.
distinction: A deck transformation must preserve the projection, not just permute fibers by an arbitrary bijection.

definitionSources.label: Allen Hatcher — Algebraic Topology
definitionSources.locator: §1.3, Deck Transformations and Group Actions, printed p. 70

translationSources.label: Bao Zhiqiang — Peking University topology syllabus

definitionEn: For a space covered by two path connected open sets with nonempty path connected intersection and a basepoint in that intersection, its fundamental group is the pushout of the two fundamental groups over that of the intersection.

example: On the unit sphere, $\gamma(t)=(\cos t,\sin t,0)$ has ambient acceleration $-\gamma(t)$, normal to the sphere, and hence zero tangential covariant acceleration.
distinction: A geodesic need not minimize length between distant endpoints. A full great-circle traversal is a geodesic although its endpoints can coincide; arbitrary reparametrization may destroy the equation.

definitionEn: Given a connection on a smooth vector bundle and a smooth path in its base, the linear map between endpoint fibers that sends an initial vector to the endpoint value of the unique section along the path with zero covariant derivative and that initial value.
definitionZh: 给定光滑向量丛上的联络及底空间中的光滑道路，由指定初值且沿道路协变导数为零的唯一截面的终值，定义两端纤维之间的线性映射。
example: For the Euclidean connection on $T\mathbb R^2$, a vector with constant Cartesian components remains parallel along any smooth path.
distinction: Transport depends on a connection and generally on the whole path, not just its endpoints. A metric-compatible connection preserves inner products, but this is additional to being a connection.

definitionEn: On a smooth real n-manifold, an equivalence class of nowhere-vanishing smooth n-forms, where two forms are equivalent when one is a positive smooth function times the other; such a class exists exactly when the manifold is orientable.
definitionZh: 在光滑实 $n$ 维流形上，处处非零的光滑 $n$ 形式的等价类；两形式相差一个正的光滑函数因子时等价。存在这样的等价类当且仅当流形可定向。
example: On $\mathbb R^2$, $dx\wedge dy$ and $e^x dx\wedge dy$ define the same orientation; $-dx\wedge dy$ defines the opposite orientation.
distinction: Orientability is existence of an orientation, whereas orientation is a choice. An orientation fixes signs in integration without selecting the lengths or areas supplied by a metric.

definitionEn: A smooth two-form on a smooth manifold whose exterior derivative is zero and whose contraction map from each tangent space to its dual is invertible.
definitionZh: 光滑流形上的光滑二形式，外微分为零，且在每一点由缩并得到的切空间到其对偶空间的映射均可逆。
example: The form $dx\wedge dy$ on $\mathbb R^2$ is symplectic. The form $x\,dx\wedge dy$ is closed but degenerates where $x=0$.
distinction: An alternating form can be nondegenerate pointwise and still fail closedness in dimension at least four. A symplectic form is the additional structure; the pair with its manifold is a symplectic manifold.

definitionEn: A smooth real bundle endomorphism of the tangent bundle of a smooth manifold whose square is minus the identity on every tangent space.
definitionZh: 光滑流形切丛的光滑实丛自同态，在每个切空间上其平方等于负恒等映射。
example: On $\mathbb R^2$, set $J\partial_x=\partial_y$ and $J\partial_y=-\partial_x$. Then $J^2=-\operatorname{id}$, the usual complex structure.
distinction: An almost complex structure is pointwise data and need not arise from holomorphic charts. Compatibility with a specified symplectic form is a separate positive-definiteness condition.

definitionEn: For a smooth real function H on a symplectic manifold with form omega, the unique smooth vector field X_H satisfying contraction of omega with X_H equals dH; this entry uses the positive-dH sign convention.
definitionZh: 对辛流形上的光滑实函数 $H$，以缩并方程 $\iota_{X_H}\omega=dH$ 唯一确定的光滑向量场；本条采用正 $dH$ 的符号约定。
example: With $\omega=dq\wedge dp$ and $H=(q^2+p^2)/2$, $X_H=p\partial_q-q\partial_p$, giving $\dot q=p$ and $\dot p=-q$.
distinction: Some authors use the opposite sign. A vector field preserving the symplectic form need not be Hamiltonian: contraction must be globally exact, rather than merely closed.

definitionEn: A smooth map from a Riemann surface with complex structure j to a smooth manifold with almost complex structure J whose differential intertwines those structures, so du composed with j equals J composed with du.
definitionZh: 从复结构为 $j$ 的黎曼曲面到近复结构为 $J$ 的光滑流形的光滑映射 $u$，满足 $du\circ j=J\circ du$。
example: For the usual structures on $\mathbb C$, $u(z)=z^2$ is pseudoholomorphic; $u(z)=\overline z$ is not, since its differential anticommutes with multiplication by $i$.
distinction: The word curve denotes a parametrized map, not just its image. The map need not be embedded or immersive; branch points and constant maps are allowed by this definition.

definitionEn: For a fixed nonnegative integer n, a Hausdorff, second countable space in which each point has a neighborhood homeomorphic to an open subset of real n-dimensional Euclidean space; boundary is excluded in this record.
definitionZh: 对固定的非负整数 $n$，具有 Hausdorff 性和第二可数性的空间，每一点都有同胚于 $n$ 维实欧氏空间开集的邻域；本条不含边界。
example: The product $S^1\times S^1$ is a two-dimensional topological manifold: products of small open arcs give coordinate neighborhoods homeomorphic to open rectangles.
distinction: No differentiability condition is imposed on chart transitions. Some authors omit second countability, yielding a broader convention; this entry includes it.

definitionEn: A Hausdorff, second countable space locally homeomorphic to relatively open subsets of the closed Euclidean half-space of a fixed positive dimension; the boundary consists of points corresponding to the bounding hyperplane in such charts.
definitionZh: 具有 Hausdorff 性和第二可数性的空间，局部同胚于固定正维数欧氏闭半空间的相对开集；对应于半空间边界超平面的点组成流形的边界。
example: The interval $[0,1]$ is a one-dimensional manifold with boundary $\{0,1\}$. Its interior points have interval charts and its endpoints have half-interval charts.
distinction: A manifold with boundary may have empty boundary. Intrinsic boundary differs from the boundary of an embedded subset: $S^1$ has no manifold boundary although it is its own boundary in $mathbb R^2$.

definitionEn: A compact topological manifold without boundary; manifolds here are Hausdorff and second countable.
definitionZh: 紧致且没有边界的拓扑流形；此处的流形具有 Hausdorff 性和第二可数性。
example: The sphere $S^2$ is closed. The compact disk $D^2$ is not a closed manifold because its boundary is $S^1$.
distinction: Closed does not merely mean closed as a subset of some ambient space. The real line is closed in itself but is not a closed manifold because it is noncompact.

definitionEn: A topological space in which every point lies in an open subset contained in some compact subspace; no Hausdorff condition is included in this definition.
definitionZh: 拓扑空间的每一点都属于某个开集，且该开集包含于一个紧致子空间中；本定义不附加 Hausdorff 条件。
example: For $x\in\mathbb R$, the open interval $(x-1,x+1)$ lies in the compact interval $[x-1,x+1]$, so $\mathbb R$ is locally compact but not compact.
distinction: In Hausdorff spaces this agrees with having a basis of neighborhoods with compact closure. Without separation hypotheses different formulations of local compactness can diverge.

definitionEn: The topology on a set whose only open subsets are the empty set and the whole set.
definitionZh: 在一个集合上，仅规定空集和全集为开集的拓扑。
example: For $X=\{a,b\}$, $\{\varnothing,X\}$ is the indiscrete topology. Both points are limits of every constant sequence in this topology.
distinction: It is the coarsest topology on the set, whereas the discrete topology is the finest. On a set with at least two points it is not Hausdorff.

definitionEn: The topology on a set whose open subsets are the empty set together with subsets having finite complement.
definitionZh: 在集合上，以空集及补集为有限集的子集作为开集的拓扑。
example: On $\mathbb N$, $\mathbb N\setminus\{1,4\}$ is open. Any two nonempty opens intersect because the union of their finite complements cannot exhaust $\mathbb N$.
distinction: On an infinite set this topology is T1 but not Hausdorff. On a finite set it coincides with the discrete topology, so the infinite-set qualification matters.

definitionEn: The topology on a set whose open subsets are the empty set together with subsets having at most countable complement; finite complements are allowed.
definitionZh: 在集合上，以空集及补集至多可数的子集作为开集的拓扑，其中允许有限补集。
example: On $\mathbb R$, $\mathbb R\setminus\mathbb Q$ is open in the cocountable topology. It is not open in the cofinite topology because its complement is infinite.
distinction: On a countable set this topology is discrete. On an uncountable set it is T1 and any two nonempty opens intersect; it is generally finer than the cofinite topology.

definitionEn: At a point of a topological space, a family of neighborhoods such that every neighborhood of that point contains a member of the family; here a neighborhood may be any set containing an open set that contains the point.
definitionZh: 在拓扑空间的一点处，由该点邻域组成的族，使任意邻域都包含族中某个成员；此处邻域允许是含有该点开邻域的任意集合。
example: The intervals $(-1/n,1/n)$, for positive integers $n$, form a neighborhood basis at zero in the usual real line.
distinction: Members need not be open under the stated convention, unlike the separate open-neighborhood sense. A neighborhood basis belongs to one point; a topology basis describes opens throughout the space.

definitionEn: A map between topological spaces that sends every open subset of its domain to an open subset of its codomain; continuity and surjectivity are not included in the definition.
definitionZh: 拓扑空间之间的映射，将定义域的每个开集映为目标空间的开集；定义本身不要求连续或满射。
example: The projection $\mathbb R^2\to\mathbb R$ onto the first coordinate is open. Its restriction to the closed set $\{(x,y):xy=1\}$ has image $\mathbb R\setminus\{0\}$, so the full projection is not closed.
distinction: Continuity concerns inverse images of opens, while openness concerns direct images. An open continuous surjection is quotient, but openness alone does not assert continuity.

definitionEn: A map between topological spaces that sends every closed subset of its domain to a closed subset of its codomain; it need not be continuous or surjective merely by this definition.
definitionZh: 拓扑空间之间的映射，将定义域的每个闭集映为目标空间的闭集；该定义本身不推出连续性或满射性。
example: The inclusion $[0,1]\hookrightarrow\mathbb R$ is closed: its domain is compact and the target Hausdorff. It is not open since $[0,1/2)$ is relatively open but not open in $\mathbb R$.
distinction: A map with a closed graph need not be a closed map. Closedness is a property of direct images, whereas continuity tests inverse images.

definitionEn: For a subspace A of a topological space X, a continuous map from X to A whose restriction to A is the identity.
definitionZh: 对拓扑空间 $X$ 的子空间 $A$，连续映射 $r:X\to A$，其在 $A$ 上的限制为恒等映射。
example: The map $r:S^1\to\{1\}$ that sends every point to $1$ is a retraction. It cannot be the endpoint of a deformation retraction of $S^1$ onto $\{1\}$ because their fundamental groups differ.
distinction: A retraction supplies a continuous projection fixing the subspace; it supplies no homotopy from the identity. The Chinese name 收缩 here has this topological sense, rather than metric contraction.

definitionEn: For a nonnegative integer n, the space of one-dimensional real linear subspaces of real (n+1)-space, topologized as the quotient of nonzero vectors by multiplication by nonzero real scalars.
definitionZh: 对非负整数 $n$，实 $(n+1)$ 维空间中一维线性子空间所成的空间；用非零向量在非零实数倍关系下的商拓扑。
example: The points $[1:2:3]$ and $[-2:-4:-6]$ in $\mathbb{RP}^2$ coincide. Equivalently, $\mathbb{RP}^2$ is the quotient of $S^2$ identifying antipodal points.
distinction: The dimension is n despite using n+1 homogeneous coordinates. This is a topological quotient over the reals, distinct from a complex projective space or an algebraic scheme construction.

english: Euler characteristic of a finite CW complex
definitionEn: For a finite CW complex, the integer obtained by summing the number of cells in each dimension with alternating signs, starting positive in dimension zero; it is independent of the chosen finite cell structure.
definitionZh: 对有限 CW 复形，以零维为正号，按维数交错求和各维胞腔数所得的整数；它不依赖所选的有限胞腔结构。
example: The torus has one zero-cell, two one-cells and one two-cell, so $\chi(T^2)=1-2+1=0$. A sphere has one zero-cell and one two-cell, giving $2$.
distinction: This is an integer invariant, not the Euler cohomology class of a vector bundle. An infinite alternating cell count is not automatically defined; the finite hypothesis is essential here.

english: genus of a closed orientable surface
definitionEn: For a connected closed orientable surface, the nonnegative integer g determined by its Euler characteristic through chi=2-2g; equivalently, the number of torus summands in its classification, with the sphere having genus zero.
definitionZh: 对连通闭可定向曲面，由 Euler 数 $\chi=2-2g$ 确定的非负整数 $g$；等价地，它是分类中环面连通和项的个数，球面的亏格为零。
example: A connected sum of two tori has $\chi=-2$, so $g=(2-(-2))/2=2$. The sphere has $\chi=2$ and genus zero.
distinction: The scope is closed orientable connected surfaces. Nonorientable genus counts crosscaps and obeys a different Euler formula; algebraic-curve genus is not defined by this unqualified surface formula.

definitionEn: A covering map for which the deck-transformation group acts transitively on each fiber, so any two points over the same base point are related by a deck transformation.
definitionZh: 复迭映射的每根纤维上，复迭变换群的作用均为传递的，即同一底点上方任意两点可由某个复迭变换相连。
example: For $p:S^1\to S^1$, $p(z)=z^n$ with $n\geq1$, multiplication by the nth roots of unity gives deck transformations acting transitively on each fiber.
distinction: Regularity concerns covering symmetries, not regular topological separation. For path connected coverings over path connected locally path connected bases, it is equivalent to normality of the associated fundamental-group subgroup.
